definitions.explanation: A reference book that catalogs kigo (seasonal words) used in haiku, organized by season. Each entry explains the word's seasonal association and often includes example haiku. An essential tool for haiku composition.

examples.japanese: {歳時記|さいじき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I looked up seasonal words in a saijiki.

examples.japanese: ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めるなら{歳時記|さいじき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧よい。
examples.english: If you start writing haiku, it's good to have one saijiki.

examples.japanese: {歳時記|さいじき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{四季|しき}→四季：11809_shiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Flipping through a saijiki, you can feel the richness of Japan's four seasons.

notes:
The {歳時記|さいじき} is indispensable for haiku poets. It categorizes ⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧ (seasonal words) into the five traditional seasons: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧ (spring), ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧ (summer), ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧ (autumn), ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧ (winter), and ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧ (New Year). Famous ones include {角川|かどかわ}{歳時記|さいじき} and ⟦{合本|がっぽん}→合本：24633_gappon⟧⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧{歳時記|さいじき}.
